Initial Windows 11 x64 preview. Choose a deadline and reserve; BatteryDeadline monitors real battery energy and applies bounded, reversible brightness, refresh-rate and DC CPU adjustments where supported.

Includes native tray, four-page UI, SQLite history/recovery, local diagnostics, read-only CLI, and the same controller running on synthetic hardware with `--simulate`.

Native UI and tray support Simplified Chinese, English, and Japanese offline. Language defaults to Windows and can be changed and saved during a session. English and Chinese documentation are included.

Download the per-user installer or portable ZIP and verify with `SHA256SUMS.txt`. WebView2 is required. Binaries are unsigned. Predictions are estimates, and cross-device discharge/sleep/performance validation is still needed. EcoQoS is deferred; this version does not modify processes.

Stop, AC, deadline and normal Quit restore settings. After a crash, restart the same mode to recover; reconnect the original display if recovery is pending. Do not delete pending recovery data. See the repository's recovery and validation documentation.
